visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with short dark hair and round glasses wearing a mustard yellow T-shirt sits at a light-colored wooden table in a restaurant. In front of him are two large ceramic bowls filled with beef noodles. He uses black chopsticks to lift a clump of noodles from the left bowl while looking directly at the camera. The background shows a modern, brightly lit restaurant interior with other patrons dining. (2) A tight close-up shot focuses on the steam-rising noodles being pulled from a deep, savory brown broth. The noodles are thin, yellowish wheat noodles, accompanied by chopped green scallions and a large, translucent slice of white radish. The camera captures the glossy texture of the noodles and the richness of the liquid from a slightly high angle. (3) The man holds a thick, rectangular slice of braised beef with his chopsticks, displaying its dark color and fibrous marbling to the viewer. He then places the meat in his mouth and chews with an expression of satisfaction. The lighting is even and bright, highlighting the texture of the beef and the steam from the bowl. (4) In a medium shot, the man picks up one of the bowls and presents it to an off-screen staff member to request a refill. He then receives a bowl containing a fresh serving of noodles and broth. He is seen at a self-service counter adding a generous amount of green pickled mustard greens from a stainless steel container into his bowl. (5) A close-up shot transitions to a square white porcelain bowl containing white tofu pudding. It is topped with separate sections of green mung beans, red adzuki beans, and a large scoop of dark purple glutinous rice. A silver spoon scoops a portion of the purple rice and tofu pudding, showing its soft and creamy consistency. (6) The man is shown back at the table eating the dessert with enjoyment. He then pans the camera toward the self-service buffet area, focusing on a large, deep stainless steel container that is completely filled with the dark purple rice mixture, illustrating the quantity of toppings available to customers.
